name: one-arm-standing-palms-in-dumbbell-press.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell with a neutral grip and assume a shoulder-width stance.
2. Raise the dumbbell to around shoulder height while maintaining a neutral grip. You can place your other hand on your waist for support. This is the starting position.
3. Slowly press the dumbbell overhead by extending the elbows and contracting the deltoids.
4. Once your arm is fully extended, begin lowering the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
5. Repeat this movement for the desired amount of reps, and then repeat with your other arm.
